selection_score: Minimum training-subset Wilson 95% win-rate lower endpoint across both bar paths; tie by sample size then name.
screening: Only earlier-period baseline trades are screened. Shortlisted rules are then fully resimulated, permitting the next qualified setup after a rejection. Screening subsets are not executable-policy backtests.

candidates.ny_only: Setup completes in New York entry session, 09:30-12:00 Eastern.
candidates.ny_first_hour_setups: Setup completes between 09:30 inclusive and 10:30 exclusive Eastern; original C3/session entry expiry remains.
candidates.directional_c2_body: C2 closes above its open for longs, below its open for shorts.
candidates.strong_rejection: C2 closes at least 65% of its own range away from its swept-side extreme.
candidates.meaningful_sweep: C2 excursion beyond C1 is at least 10% of C1 range.
candidates.efficient_price_action: Prior 20 completed minute closes have directional efficiency at least 0.30.
candidates.minimum_reward_12_points: Planned distance from entry trigger to C1 target is at least 12 MNQ points.
candidates.hourly_bias_aligned: The existing causal hourly-bias proxy agrees with setup direction.
candidates.skip_mondays: Setup's New York calendar weekday is not Monday.

caveats: All thresholds and selection rules are fixed before this filter study, not optimized individually.
This year has already been inspected in earlier work. Later-period validation is retrospective, not pristine or prospective out-of-sample evidence.
Only single filters are considered. No combinations, weekday search or threshold grid.
No later-period outcome is used to choose the shortlist or substitute another filter.
Fees, slippage, whole-contract compounding and rollover data-mark assumptions match the 1% sizing study.
Broker margin, quantity limits and liquidity remain unmodeled. High/low paths are hypotheses, not observed ticks.
